description: Sitemaps submitted for a property (or listed in a sitemap index): type, last submitted/downloaded, pending, errors, warnings and submitted URL counts per content type. Google no longer reports indexed counts per sitemap; use inspect_url for single URLs.

site_url.description: Search Console property exactly as list_sites shows it: "sc-domain:example.com" for a domain property, or a URL prefix with its trailing slash, e.g. "https://www.example.com/".

sitemap_index.description: Only list the sitemaps in this sitemap index URL.

name: list_sitemaps
title: List sitemaps
